## Summary

Describe the change, why it is needed, and any related issue.

## Verification

List the exact commands run and their outcomes. Note relevant checks that were
not run and why.

## Screenshots

For visible UI changes, include before/after screenshots with shareable data and
note the themes/viewports reviewed. Remove this section when not applicable.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and follows the existing architecture.
- [ ] Relevant checks passed; behavior changes have appropriate regression coverage.
- [ ] Documentation is updated where necessary.
- [ ] No credentials, personal media, local databases, or generated output are included.
